speciesNames: A Slime Digimon born from the fusion of a PC virus and negative human emotions. It lives in wet places and spits a poisonous froth.
A small, red-eyed Machine Digimon. It discharges electricity from its tail. It cannot move in dark places, so it lives in well lit areas.
A Seed Digimon with a clear film on its body. It has potential to digivolve into a Vegetation or Dragon Digimon. It lives where plants are abundant.
A Slime Digimon that looks like a green bubble. It stops an enemy with its bubbles and then flees.

mails.text: Welcome to the Digital World. Enter your name and register yourself as a tamer.
You are now a Digimon Tamer. Strive to win the Digimon Championship along with your Digimon. You should be receiving a gift soon.
It's time to enter a battle.
First, let's train the Digimon and enter the "Ace of Spring" title match that will be held on the 3rd day  of Spring!
Digimon will get sick if they are in dirty cages! Clean the cages often!
Food will rot after some time! Digimon that eat rotten food will get sick!
Are you checking the schedule often? Have your Digimon prepared for the day of the title match!
Digimon that are stressed out are more prone to injury! Don't put too many Digimon in a small cage!
If you leave weakened Digimon in the infirmary, they will slowly recover!
If you run out of bits and can't buy food, your Digimon will starve to death. Be careful!
When you want more bits, enter the Free Battles to win some prize money! Be careful not to challenge opponents that are too strong!
When a Digimon is small and In-Training, train it by focusing on an ability. That's the way to alter the course of its digivolution!
Battle counts are important in digivolving! Your Digimon may digivolve into powerful Digimon if you fight lots of battles!
A stressed out Digimon will have a hazy head!
Digivolution is the quickest way to become stronger! When a Digimon digivolves, it matures dramatically!
A Digimon's Capacity is like its weight! It increases when a Digimon digivolves!
As you win title matches and collect medals, your Tamer Rank increases and you are able to add more Digimon to your group!
Are you keeping track of the capacity of all your Digimon in the Digimon menu? Be ready to digivolve by having at least a cushion of 10G.
Different Digimon appear in the same hunting grounds depending on whether it is day or night!
When an icon is displayed above a Digimon, it needs your attention! Take good care of it!
When a Digimon digivolves, you can lose it if it exceeds capacity! Make sure you have enough capacity!
When your tamer rank increases, you become eligible to enter more title matches!
How many times a Digimon becomes a DigiEgg is an important part of its digivolution! It is key in digivolving into a strong Mega Digimon!
Cage training makes Digimon hungry. When Digimon train, reward them with food!
Heal a Digimon's injury or illness early on with either bandages or medicine! Be careful because Digimon can die if left unattended!
If you want to use a lot of special attacks, increase TP! There are supposedly Digimon that have three special attacks!
Digimon are more lively during the warm seasons of Spring and Summer! It's the perfect time for training!
If you run out of items, stock up at the shop! It's common sense for a tamer to always have food and medicine on hand!
As your Tamer Rank goes up, more gates to hunting grounds become available!
Friendship can be born between Digimon! If a Digimon is alone in a cage all the time, it is difficult for friendships to grow!
If Digimon are left alone, they digivolve on their own. Neglect their training and they can become slovenly Digimon!
Feed Digimon protein and their attack power increases during battle! However, they also become more prone to injury!
You can enter title matches from 7:00 to 15:00! Keep track of the time so you don't miss your chance!
After buying a new item, make sure you change your settings before going on a hunt!
If you grab your Digimon and move them around from cage to cage often, they grow faster!
TP stands for Technical Points. TP are expended when a Digimon uses a special attack or support (SP)!
To enter the championship, you need to win the preliminaries at least once within the three years leading up to it.
Watch out for a team called the Wild Giggers! They've trained many Digimon with an emphasis on power!
Tamers each have training licenses. When Tamer Rank increases, it is possible to achieve a higher level of digivolution!
There are many battles held in Autumn! Get your Digimon in good condition and participate in as many as you can!
After buying a new cage, go to Cage Edit to change your cage! Put your Digimon in it and you may see some new transformations occur!
The key to relieving Digimon stress is to make them happy! If they get stressed out, they become ill!
Don't give up even if your Digimon becomes a DigiEgg! Its soul is passed on and there is a chance it will become an even stronger Digimon!
The preliminaries and the championship are both held on the 5th day of Autumn! Increase your Tamer Rank and go for the challenge!
During a hunt, a high level tamer can use items other than a rope effectively. Devise a plan and lure Digimon into a trap!
The weather can change depending on when you go on a hunt!
When your Tamer Rank increases, your Cage Space increases too!
Have you seen the Digipedia in the Database? A tamer can have fun collecting various Digimon and filling it up!
During battle, the actions of a Digimon differ based on its nature!
Even Digimon supposedly have charisma! Digimon with high charisma are highly trusted by their friends!
Digivolved Digimon are recorded in the Digipedia! Once the records are complete, something good might happen!
When you want to hunt for a long time, it's best to go out in the morning!
There is an urban legend that says that a tamer released a Digimon during a hunt and was reunited with it at the same spot!
Observe your Digimon closely! Even though they don't talk, you should be able to understand their feelings!
Sometimes you can see what a Digimon will digivolve into when you touch it right after its parameters increase from training!
Sukamon is hard to train! Good luck!
Some Digimon will get stressed out by being near selfish Digimon!
A Digimon that has become a DigiEgg still has some of its memories left. It can digivolve more easily along the same path it did before!
A waste filled cage can cause some Digimon to be stressed! Be sure to clean the cages often.
While on a hunt, be on the lookout for Digimon that move quickly, as they may have rare abilities!
It's difficult to wake up a lazy Digimon once it falls asleep, even if you touch it!
To train Digimon for several generations is one way of getting stronger! Don't worry about failing, just take your time!
Digimon like some cages more than others depending on the Digimon! Some Digimon even like dark wet cages!
Dragon and Beast, Aquatic and Bird, InsectPlant and Machine, Holy and Dark are all antagonists of each other!
When a Digimon is being disobedient, it is easier to grab it by touching it while pressing お or か !
Digimon that get along with each other will do things together, like sing to relieve stress!
The Digital World has four seasons. The seasons change every eight days!
Summer is the season for training! Parameters increase more easily than usual!
Autumn is the season for battles! There are lots of title matches!
Be careful during Winter training! Training too hard makes Digimon prone to injury!
Digimon move from place to place as the seasons change. You can hunt different Digimon depending on the season.
Spring and Autumn are the best times to go on hunts! Lots of Digimon are out so they're easier to catch!
During the cold seasons of Autumn and Winter are when the Dark species Digimon come out!
They say rare Digimon that you don't see often come out in the Winter. It's good to hunt in the Winter sometimes!
It's Spring! How about going on a hunt? The Digimon are active and there are many outside!
Wow, the Summer is hot. Yes, indeed it is. It's the ideal season to train your Digimon!
Autumn is the season that stirs the appetite! Digimon eat a lot during this time so be careful!
Make use of the Winter to shop for items and prepare for the busy Spring!
Spring is here again! Spring is the best time to hunt Beast and Bird Digimon!
Digimon don't come outside in the Summer since it's so hot. However, Insectoid Digimon are easy to hunt even in the Summer!
There are many title matches in Autumn, with the Digimon Championship as the highlight! Win the battles of Autumn!
I have nothing left to teach you! I hope that you become a great Digimon tamer! Well, I'll see you around!
When Digimon are hungry, feed them food or protein.
A Digimon that is stressed out will become sick if left alone. Take it to the infirmary or pet it often.
When a Digimon gets sick, cure it with medicine. If you neglect it, it will begin to die.
If a Digimon gets injured, heal it with a bandage. If you neglect it, it will begin to die.
If you do not tend to a Digimon's low HP, illness, injuries, or hunger, it will begin to die. A dying Digimon may be lost and disappear.
A Digimon has digivolved. A Digimon will digivolve when its status is raised to meet the criteria, or after a certain amount of time.
When a Digimon reaches the end of its life, it will be lost and disappear. If it has fought at least ten battles, it turns into a DigiEgg.
A Digimon has turned into a DigiEgg. Digimon that were not lost and turn into a DigiEgg will be reborn stronger than before.
Congratulations on completing all the title matches! You got a free ticket! Now you can go on hunts all you want for free!
Congratulations! You can control 1 Digimon now! い =Attack あ, う, え =Sp. Attack お, か =Support START=Change
Whenever capacity is exceeded and you cannot digivolve, reduce your Digimon by releasing them on the hunt map or deleting them!
If you don't let your Digimon battle or don't pay them attention, they'll escape from your cage. Escaped Digimon will never return.

New items have arrived! Please try them!
Congratulations! Here's a gift from me. Take it!
That was a great battle. Here's a gift from us. Train it well.
I haven't experienced such a heated battle in a while. How would you like to train Guilmon with that passion of yours?
It looks like you've been steadily improving. This is a gift from me. I'm sure it'll be useful to you.
I'm amazed at your Digimon's power. Here's a Digimon I would like you to train so please take it. I'm counting on you.
Here, take this! It's a DigiEgg of a legendary Digimon. It's said to be the ancestor of all Dramon. It yields great power, so be careful!
Aahh! My Digimon escaped! Someone please catch it! Take care of it while you're at it!
Do you believe in fate?
I think VictoryGreymon likes you. Take good care of it.
Well done! Here's a gift for your Digimon too!
That was a terrrific battle! This joy should be shared with your Digimon! Here's a prize!
Wow, that battle was even better than usual! Now, let's celebrate! Congratulations!
Congratulations! You finally did it! It's not much, but here's a sincere gift from me!

Hi! I heard you started training Digimon recently. Me too! Well then, let's have a battle!
Hey! How are your Digimon doing? Do you want to get some practice before the next battle?
Hi! All of my Digimon are just itching for a fight! How about taking them on?
Hey! I noticed that you suddenly have quite a few medals. I also have about the same as you! Well then, let's see how strong you really are!!
Hey there, rival! Yeah, that's right! It's the usual challenge! It always comes when you let your guard down!
Hi! I've gotten pretty famous. I get fan letters now! Pretty cool, huh? My Tamer name is Mother. Oh well, let's fight!
Hey, bro! I never imagined I'd have such a great team like I do now! Anyway, enough talk! Let's fight!!
Hi, my other self! This Digimon I found during a hunt yesterday is really feisty! The free battles just aren't challenging enough for it!
Hey, buddy! We've been at it for a while, so we're pretty strong now, aren't we? Let's battle each other and give it our all for once!!
Hey, soul mate! How's it going? Everybody's talking about you these days. So, how'd you like to battle me!? C'mon, let's battle!
Hello! I'm just starting out so I might be really weak. But since I have my Digimon now, I want to fight! Please accept my challenge.
I saw your battle the other day! You were so cool! I'd like to win like that too. Do you think you can give me some pointers?
Please listen! The precious Digimon that Mom gave me for my birthday is dying. It's sad...but let me do battle with it one last time!
Hello! I've trained my Digimon to be about the same level as yours. If you have the time, would you like to battle?
Hello! I've won quite a few matches myself so I've gained some confidence recently! So, how about a match?
A strange person came by suddenly and gave me a Digimon! I was told to fight you with it. Anyway, please accept my challenge!
Hello! Everyone's gotten pretty strong lately and it's hard to keep up. Please train me to be able to battle the others!
Hello! I trained each of my Digimon very carefully and now I feel like I finally have a team! Please accept my challenge!
Hello! I've been thinking lately. I want to have a serious battle with you. I've gotten stronger, so let's battle!
Long time no see. Do you remember when I was just starting out? I really looked up to you. How about another match?
Wanna battle?
Let's battle.
Come on. Let's battle.
Hey. Let's battle.
Please. Let's battle.
I'm begging you... Let's battle!
It'll be fun! Let's battle!
You have to battle!
It won't hurt to battle.
Battle...uh huh.
Accept my challenge! I'll pulverize you!
Come and get me! You're a wimp!!
Wanna take me on? Come on, I'll end it quick!
Hey, come on and fight me! Sure, I'll go easy. You'll need to come with everything you've got!
I'll take you on! Now, give it your best shot!
It's just you and me! It's simple. You lose and I win!
I'll teach you a lesson! Heheheh! I can't wait to hear you whine!
You want to beat me? Fine, I'll give you a　chance!
I'm very strong! Wanna take me on? It's no big deal for the likes of you to run if you want. I'll be laughing my heart out, though!
I want to act like I'm strong too!!
Aloha! Having a good time training Digimon? Oh, me? I'm in Hawaii! It's so convenient now that we can battle from anywhere in the world!
Ni hao! I just found a real winner! Let's have a quick fight!
Hello! ...Hm? Are you a guy or a girl? Hm, it doesn't matter. Let's battle!
Bonjour! I love a man with passion! I'm a passionate woman!! Passionate about Digimon!
Annyong haseyo! Would I be old if I said I couldn't follow trends? What does my age matter anyway?!
Zdravstvuite! What?! How should I know what language that is?!
Guten Tag! What's up? Why don't you stop spending time with Digimon all day and go out on a date sometime!?
Listen to this! Dave spends time with Alice all day and doesn't spend any time with me. How annoying! Ugh! Let's just battle already!
Al salaam a'alaykum! Hard to say, isn't it? Anyway, wanna battle or what?
Yoohoo! How's it going? Not much happening with me. But at any rate, how about a battle?!
I never thought you'd make it to the championship. I am the founder of this tournament. Show me what a champion is made of!!
So, do you want to try again? Your Digimon's strength is within my range.
Today is a nice day. Could it be because of Sunmon?
Are you eating alright? If you don't, you'll end up like Numemon.
The other day I put Kunemon in the jungle and it turned into a big beetle! I was shocked!
If you get tired of raising a Digimon, you can let it go. You'll see it again.
When I exposed Etemon to a lot of virus, it turned silver! I was so surprised!
I was making Darcmon fight battles and increasing her Dark. Now she's become a naughty girl! No one can stand up to her now!
Floramon is so cute and smells so nice. So very soothing.
It's so confusing with names like GaoGamon, Garurumon, and Gururumon.
Whamon is huge. How cool...
Everyone knows that Gomamon digivolves into Ikkakumon! You just have to battle!
